# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side:**
  - "Activities" button
  - "Files" button
- **Center:**
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:04"
- **Right Side:**
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background:** Geometric abstract wallpaper with gradient from purple to red
- **Desktop Icon:**
  - "Home" folder icon located at bottom right corner

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom:**
  - Google Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Terminal icon (command line)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon (application launcher)

## Active Windows

### Terminal Window
- **Title Bar:**
  - Text: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **Terminal Content:**
  - Command prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor at end of prompt

### File Manager Window
- **Title Bar:**
  - Path: "Home / Downloads"
  - Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
  - Search icon
  - View options (list, grid, etc.)
- **Navigation Panel (Left Side):**
  - "Recent"
  - "Starred"
  - "Home"
  - "Desktop"
  - "Documents"
  - "Downloads" (highlighted)
  - "/home/user/Downloads" (path shown)
  - "Pictures"
  - "Videos"
  - "Trash"
  - "Other Locations"
- **File List (Right Side):**
  - "MediaLibrary.zip" (ZIP archive icon)
  - "locked" (folder icon)
  - "license.key" (PGP key icon)
  - "decrypt.sh" (shell script icon)

## Window Layout
- Terminal window positioned on the left side of the screen
- File manager window positioned on the right side of the screen
- Both windows are overlapping slightly, with the file manager window partially covering the terminal window
